language.label: Language
language.tip: Language for the minimap. Automatic follows the FUSE App.

display.title: Minimap
display.aliveTip: While you drive, aim or use an ability.
display.mapTip: While the tactical map is open.
display.deployTip: On the deploy screen and the spawn drop.
display.viewUpTip: The map turns, so the way you look is always up
display.northUpTip: The map stays still, and your arrow turns
display.rangeTip: Distance from you to the edge of the minimap
display.zoomRangeTip: Distance to the edge while you hold the Zoom Out key
display.pointScaleTip: Size of the base hexes. 1× is the size in the game radar
display.radarRingTip: Marks the 300 m limit. The radar shows no blip outside it
display.safeConeTip: Shades the zone outside your view. If an enemy is detected outside of it, a warning plays
display.classIconsTip: BETA: Shows each player's class instead of a dot. Works only for marked players in your FOV

warn.title: Rear Warning
warn.description: A tone plays when the radar finds a new enemy outside your view. The tone comes from that side: left, right or a lower tone for behind
warn.coneTip: Width of the front zone around your view that stays silent. 180° is everything in front of you
warn.rangeTip: Only enemies this close trigger warn
warn.invertTip: Warn only for enemies farther than the warning range
warn.missilesTip: Warn when an enemy missile flies straight at you, from any side

colors.title: Colours
colors.description: Game colours by default. Double-click a swatch to reset it.
colors.allyTip: Allies and bases your team holds.
colors.enemyTip: Enemies, enemy bases and the warning.
colors.neutralTip: The frame of a base no team holds.

radar.title: Game Radar
radar.description: Hide the game's radar when the minimap replaces it, or draw the same map inside it, under its blips.
radar.hideTip: Hides the radar in the top-right corner. The minimap keeps working: it reads the radar data, not the picture
radar.nearTip: Exact to 100 m. The game radar packs the 100-300 m band tighter, so far blips sit closer than the map
radar.fullTip: Shows all 300 m. Near blips then sit farther out than the map

overlays.title: Map Overlays
overlays.description: Your own marks, areas and routes on each map, such as Kill Confirmed tokens or good positions for a vehicle.
overlays.editorTip: Press Ctrl+I (interactive mode) to draw, then Done to return
overlays.note: Each mark can show only in some modes, for some classes or for some vehicles. A mark with no filter shows in every match on its map.

editor.title: Overlay Editor
editor.atMeTip: Use your position for the mark or the next corner (Ctrl+M)
editor.atMeOff: Join a match on this map to use your position
editor.locked: Press Ctrl+I (FUSE interactive mode) to draw and edit
editor.hintDrive: Ctrl+M puts a mark at your position while you drive.
editor.hintPoint: Click the map to place {mark}. Esc cancels.
editor.hintAreaMore: Click the first corner or double-click to finish. Esc cancels.
editor.hintPathMore: Double-click or Enter to finish. Esc cancels.
editor.hintSelected: Drag the shape or its corners. Right-click a corner to remove it. Del deletes.
editor.hintIdle: Pick a mark above, or click a shape to edit it. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
editor.label: Label
